message.content: On October 19, 2026, at 19:00, ChaeSong-hwa proposed starting the karaoke night with classic songs like "Sweet Home Alabama" or "Let It Be." He also mentioned that they could include some pop hits such as "Shallow" or "Shake It Off" to create a well-rounded mix. Additionally, he suggested throwing in some of their previous favorites. LiHua was enthusiastic about these suggestions, indicating her willingness to participate in a variety of genres, including pop and classics.
